meta.name: quotes
meta.description: The quote package's settings (191, plan F-quote-package B4c, jav/quote_proposal.py). proposal: a person asks for the quote's proposal on the package's page and the worker matches each requested item with the active price list, with the application's AI engine; max_item_usd is the budget reserved per requested item and provider (the button shows the sum as the proposal's cost cap; a call reserves its worst case first, measured 2026-10-21 on the invented golden set: at most 0.0015 USD JEV and 0.024 USD OpenAI per item reserved, at most 0.00015 and 0.002 spent); max_items: the most requested items one proposal asks about. draft (192, B5, jav/quote_draft.py): max_lines is the most lines a quote's draft holds. letter (196, plan F-Word-output W3, jav/quote_letter.py): max_usd is the budget the reply letter's paragraph reserves (GPT; the button shows it as the cost cap), max_chars the longest paragraph the code's check lets through.

changelog.note: 191 (plan F-quote-package B4c): the proposal's budget per requested item (JEV 0.003 USD, OpenAI 0.03 USD) and its most items (200).
192 (plan F-quote-package B5): the quote's draft holds at most 300 lines.
196 (plan F-Word-output W3): the reply letter's paragraph: its budget (OpenAI 0.02 USD) and its longest text (700 characters).
